components.name: Truncate
components.description:
One line of text that ends in an ellipsis when it doesn't fit, with the
full text in a tooltip. For a tooltip of your own, use `tooltip` rather than
wrapping it in a `Tooltip`.

props.name: tooltip
props.description:
Shown above the full text when truncated, alone otherwise. Hover only: also
provide it elsewhere.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description:
A short hint on a focusable element that isn't a control, shown on hover
and keyboard focus. Controls take a `tooltip` prop. Never the only label.

props.name: tooltip
props.description:
What it shows. Array entries stack 8px apart; empty ones are skipped.
Nothing to show: never opens.

props.name: description
props.description:
The trigger's description for screen readers; defaults to `tooltip`. Omit
text the trigger already says; `null` for none.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger: an element, or a component that passes its props to one.

components.name: Textarea
components.description:
A multi-line text field: a description, a note, a message. Shows 3 lines by
default; the user can drag it taller. In a form, wire it through
`Controller`; `delay` saves as the user types. One line of text is an Input.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description:
The ids of elements that name the control, like a section's heading,
for a control with no `label`.

props.name: id
props.description: The control's id; generated when left out.

props.name: name
props.description: The control's name; else the label, the placeholder, then the id.

props.name: hint
props.description: Shown in a tooltip from the info icon after the label.

props.name: labelRightSlot
props.description: At the end of the label's row; shown only with a label.

props.name: error
props.description:
Each status takes `true` for the style alone, or a message to show.
Error wins over warning, and warning over success.

props.name: look
props.description: Space-separated styles: `outline` (default) or `open`.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Shown on hover over the box, above any disabled reason.

props.name: ref
props.description: Reaches the control's focusable element.

props.name: delay
props.description:
`onChange` waits this many ms without typing; the text shows at once.
Blur and unmounting send a waiting edit at once.

components.name: Tag
components.description:
A short label that only informs: a status, a category, a count, or a
chosen filter the user removes with its close button (`closable`). A tag
is never clicked: a toggle is a Chip, an action a Button.

props.name: look
props.description: Space-separated styles: `!bordered` drops the border.

props.name: closable
props.description: Adds a close button, read as "Remove" and the label.

props.name: closeRef
props.description:
The close button. Removing the tag removes the focused button, so move
focus to the next tag's close button.

props.name: closeTabIndex
props.description: `-1` inside a widget that moves focus between its tags itself.

props.name: tooltip
props.description:
On a closable tag, the close button shows it with the disabled reason on
hover and focus, and screen readers read both. A tag that can't close
takes no focus, so only hover shows them: nothing essential here.

components.name: Tab
components.description:
One tab of a Tabs: `title` and icons in the tab list, children as the
panel shown while it's active. It renders nothing itself.

props.name: value
props.description: Names the tab for `activeTab` and `onTabChange`.

props.name: title
props.description: Shown in the tab list, between the icons.

props.name: children
props.description: The panel, rendered while the tab is active.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description:
Renders the panel from the start and hides it while another tab is
active, so what it keeps itself, like scroll position, survives.

components.name: Tabs
components.description:
Views of one subject that share a place on the page, one shown at a time:
a session's details, speakers and feedback. Its `Tab` children are the
tabs, each with its panel. Another page is a Link, not a tab.

props.name: activeTab
props.description:
The active tab's `value`. Without it, Tabs keeps its own, starting at the
first enabled tab; with every tab disabled, none is active.

props.name: children
props.description: `Tab` elements, one per tab.

props.name: className
props.description: For the root, around the tab list and the panel.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the tab list, for a page with more than one.

components.name: Table
components.description:
Rows of records to scan, sort, filter, select and act on. Configure with
`Table.*` children: a `Table.Column` per column, plus the features needed
(`Table.Selection`, `Table.Pagination`, …).

props.name: rowKey
props.description: A row's identity: the same key for the same row on every render.

props.name: caption
props.description: Accessible name of the table.

props.name: virtualized
props.description: Renders only visible rows; give the container a fixed height.

props.name: onRowClick
props.description:
A click on a row outside its controls: a pointer shortcut for its main
action. Keyboard and screen-reader users can't click a row, so the action
must also be a link or button in the row, like a `Link` in its name cell.
Ignored with `Table.Expansion`, where a row click toggles the row.

components.name: Table.Column
components.description: Config component: registers its props and renderer; renders nothing.

props.name: rowHeader
props.description:
Names each row, like an attendee's name: its cells are row headers, read
with every cell of the row, and its value names the row's controls ("Select
Ada Lovelace"). One per table; without one, the first column with a value
does.

props.name: computed
props.type: ((value: T[keyof T & string], row: T) => C) | ((value: undefined, row: T) => C)

components.name: Table.Sort
components.description: Config component: controlled with `value`, uncontrolled otherwise.

components.name: Table.Filter
components.description: Config component: controlled with `value`, uncontrolled otherwise.

components.name: Table.Selection
components.description: Config component: adds the selection column; controlled with `value`.

props.name: isRowSelectable
props.description: `false` leaves the cell empty, unless the row is already selected.

props.name: isRowDisabled
props.description: `true` shows a disabled checkbox; select-all leaves the row as is.

components.name: Table.Expansion
components.description: Config component: adds the expansion column; controlled with `value`.

props.name: isRowExpandable
props.description: `false` leaves the cell empty, unless the row is already expanded.

props.name: isRowDisabled
props.description: `true` shows a disabled expand button.

components.name: Table.Reorder
components.description: Config component: adds the drag handle column.

props.name: isRowDisabled
props.description: `true` disables the row's drag handle; other rows still move past it.

components.name: Table.Pagination
components.description: Config component: controlled with `value`, uncontrolled otherwise.

props.name: size
props.description:
`full` (default): First, Previous, up to five page numbers, Next, Last.
`minimal`: Previous, the current page, Next.

props.name: content
props.description: First, Previous, Next and Last as words (default) or icons.

props.name: pageSizeOptions
props.description: Page sizes to pick from; the first is the default.

props.name: totalItems
props.description: Server mode: rows matching the current filters.

props.name: unfilteredTotalItems
props.description: Server mode: rows before filtering, shown in the filtered stat.

components.name: Table.InfiniteScroll
components.description: Config component: server mode loads more rows as the body nears its end.

props.name: totalItems
props.description: Rows matching the current filters; loading stops once `data` has them all.

props.name: onLoadMore
props.description: Called when the body nears its end, and by the footer's load more button.

components.name: Switch
components.description:
A switch labeled by its children, to its right: a setting that takes effect
when flipped, like notifications. A choice confirmed by a form's submit is a
Checkbox.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether it's on: yours to hold in state, with `onCheckedChange`.

props.name: hint
props.description: Shown in a tooltip from the info icon after the label.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Shown on hover over the track, and on focus, above any reason.

props.name: id
props.description: The track's id; generated when left out.

props.name: className
props.description: For the row, around the track and its label.

props.name: style
props.description: For the row, around the track and its label.

props.name: children
props.description: The label, to the right of the track.

components.name: MultiSelect
components.description:
A form field for choosing several values from a list: teams, tracks,
speakers. Each chosen value is a removable tag, and the menu stays open
while choosing. One value: Select.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description:
The ids of elements that name the control, like a section's heading,
for a control with no `label`.

props.name: id
props.description: The control's id; generated when left out.

props.name: name
props.description: The control's name; else the label, the placeholder, then the id.

props.name: hint
props.description: Shown in a tooltip from the info icon after the label.

props.name: labelRightSlot
props.description: At the end of the label's row; shown only with a label.

props.name: error
props.description:
Each status takes `true` for the style alone, or a message to show.
Error wins over warning, and warning over success.

props.name: look
props.description: Space-separated styles: `outline` (default) or `open`.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Shown on hover over the box, above any disabled reason.

props.name: ref
props.description: Reaches the control's focusable element.

props.name: allowClear
props.description: Lets the user clear the selection, with Delete or the clear button.

props.name: showCheckbox
props.description: A checkbox before each option, ticked when selected.

props.name: showCheckmark
props.description: A check mark after each selected option; on by default.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Runs once focus leaves the Select: trigger, search and menu.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names a Select without a label; the placeholder does otherwise.

props.name: className
props.description: For the field's root.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The values in selection order, and their options in that order.

props.name: renderTrigger
props.type: ((trigger: { selected: SelectOptionData<V, D>[]; open: boolean; }) => ReactNode)
props.description: Replaces the tags.

props.name: children
props.description: `SelectOption` elements, one per option, or in `SelectGroup`s.

components.name: Select
components.description:
A form field for choosing one value from a list: a venue, a ticket type, a
sort order. Its options are `SelectOption` children; typing filters them,
or `onSearch` asks the server. Several values: MultiSelect.

props.description:
The ids of elements that name the control, like a section's heading,
for a control with no `label`.

props.name: id
props.description: The control's id; generated when left out.

props.name: name
props.description: The control's name; else the label, the placeholder, then the id.

props.name: hint
props.description: Shown in a tooltip from the info icon after the label.

props.description: At the end of the label's row; shown only with a label.

Each status takes `true` for the style alone, or a message to show.
Error wins over warning, and warning over success.

props.name: look
props.description: Space-separated styles: `outline` (default) or `open`.

props.description: Runs once focus leaves the Select: trigger, search and menu.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names a Select without a label; the placeholder does otherwise.

props.name: className
props.description: For the field's root.

props.name: value
props.description: `''` is nothing selected.

props.name: onChange
props.type: (value: "" | V, option: SelectOptionData<V, D> | undefined) => void

props.type: ((trigger: { selected: SelectOptionData<V, D>; open: boolean; }) => ReactNode)
props.description: Replaces the selected label.

props.name: children
props.description: `SelectOption` elements, one per option, or in `SelectGroup`s.

components.name: SelectGroup
components.description:
A labelled group of options in a Select's menu: sessions by day, venues by
city. Its children are `SelectOption` elements.

props.name: label
props.description: Shown above the group's options, and names the group.

props.name: children
props.description: The group's `SelectOption` elements.

components.name: SelectOption
components.description:
One option of a Select or MultiSelect. It renders nothing itself: `value`
and `label` are the option, its children draw its menu row, and other props
are data passed to `onChange`.

props.name: label
props.description: What the trigger shows and search matches.

props.name: children
props.description: The row's content in the menu; the label without it.

components.name: Section
components.description:
A titled part of a page: a heading, an optional muted description, then its
content, with the same sizes and spacing everywhere. A section inside a
section gets the next heading level. One that opens and closes is a
Collapsible, several are an Accordion.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading's text; its level comes from how deep the section sits.

props.name: description
props.description: A muted line under the heading that says what the section holds.

props.name: headerAction
props.description: Controls at the header's end, like a Create button.

props.name: titleId
props.description: The heading's id, for a control it names with `aria-labelledby`.

props.name: headingAs
props.description:
The heading element, over the one nesting picks: `h1` for the page's
own title. Sections inside follow from it; the size stays the same.

components.name: FlexScrollArea
components.description:
A ScrollArea for a flex column, like a panel or dialog body: it takes its
content's height until the column is full, then scrolls.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
The scroll directions; `both` by default. `vertical` leaves wide content,
like a table, to scroll sideways itself.

props.name: ref
props.description: Reaches the scrolling element; every other prop goes on the root.

components.name: ScrollArea
components.description:
A box that scrolls its own content, for a box with its own height (`h-*`
or `max-h-*`). Scrollbars show while the content overflows.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
The scroll directions; `both` by default. `vertical` leaves wide content,
like a table, to scroll sideways itself.

props.name: ref
props.description: Reaches the scrolling element; every other prop goes on the root.

components.name: UIRoot
components.description:
The app's `<html>` and `<body>`, rendered once in the root layout: global
styles, the light or dark theme before first paint, the tooltip provider
and the toast queue. The app puts its own error boundary inside it, around
its pages.

props.name: lang
props.description: The page's language, read by screen readers and translators.

components.name: Radio
components.description: One choice of a RadioGroup, with its label, its children, to its right.

props.name: value
props.description: What choosing it sets its RadioGroup's value to.

props.name: hint
props.description: Shown in a tooltip from the info icon after the label.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Shown on hover over the radio, and on focus, above any reason.

props.name: id
props.description: The radio's id; generated when left out.

props.name: className
props.description: For the row, around the radio and its label.

props.name: style
props.description: For the row, around the radio and its label.

props.name: children
props.description: The label, to the right of the radio.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description:
Radios for one choice from a few visible ones, like a ticket type. A form
field with label, help text and error; no layout: lay out with `className`.

props.name: id
props.description: The control's id; generated when left out.

props.name: hint
props.description: Shown in a tooltip from the info icon after the label.

props.name: error
props.description:
Each status takes `true` for the style alone, or a message to show.
Error wins over warning, and warning over success.

props.name: name
props.description: The control's name; else the label, the placeholder, then the id.

props.name: labelRightSlot
props.description: At the end of the label's row; shown only with a label.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Runs once focus leaves the group.

props.name: ref
props.description: Reaches the group's element, which takes focus from its label.

components.name: Popover
components.description:
A panel of the caller's own content opened from a button: a filter form, a
details card, a quick edit. A non-modal dialog by default: focus moves in on
open and back to the trigger on close; Escape, a click outside or tabbing
out closes it.

props.name: children
props.description: One trigger element that forwards refs, events and attributes.

props.name: menu
props.description: The content, with its own padding and layout.

props.name: align
props.description: Defaults to `end`.

props.name: modal
props.description: Keeps focus in the content and blocks the page while open; default `false`.

props.name: menuClassName
props.description: For the content, which renders outside the trigger's parent.

components.name: PopoverButton
components.description:
A Popover's trigger: a base Button with an up-down chevron that shows the
Popover's disabled or loading state and reason in its own tooltip.

props.name: tooltip
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<...> | null
props.description:
Shown on hover and focus, above any state reason. Read as the description
unless it repeats the name.

props.name: leftIcon
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<...> | null

props.name: rightIcon
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<...> | null

props.name: leftAddOn
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<...> | null

props.name: rightAddOn
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<...> | null

props.name: look
props.description: Space-separated styles, in any order: `ghost`, `rounded`.

props.name: as
props.description:
Forwards props, ref and className to the interactive root, whose look
Button owns; inline styles and important rules override it.

components.name: Pagination
components.description:
Pages of a long list: "Showing 11 to 20 of 95 items" on the left, then a
page-size select and First, Previous, page numbers, Next and Last. A table's
pages are `Table.Pagination`, built on it.

props.name: size
props.description:
`full` (default): First, Previous, up to five page numbers, Next, Last.
`minimal`: Previous, the current page, Next.

props.name: content
props.description: First, Previous, Next and Last as words (default) or icons.

props.name: pageSizeOptions
props.description: Page sizes to pick from; the first is the default.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the page navigation, unique on the page: "Sessions pagination".

props.name: totalItems
props.description: Items across every page; the page count comes from it.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled: pass with `onChange`. A new page size starts at page one.

props.name: showInfo
props.description: "Showing 11 to 20 of 95 items" beside the controls (default).

props.name: itemName
props.description: The items' name, one and many: `['session', 'sessions']`.

props.name: filtered
props.description: The items are filtered: counted as matches.

props.name: unfilteredTotal
props.description: Items before filtering: "Filtered from 120".

props.name: selectedCount
props.description: Items chosen across pages: "3 sessions selected".

components.name: MenuGroup
components.description: Rows of a Popover's content kept together, apart from the next group.

components.name: MenuItem
components.description:
A row's look: icon, label, add-ons and a selected row's check, for rows
inside a Popover's content. No behavior of its own: wrap it in a
PlainButton to press it. For a menu of actions or choices use a Dropdown,
whose rows bring menu roles and arrow keys.

props.name: selected
props.description: Left out on a row with no checked state, like an action.

props.name: checkbox
props.description: A checkbox before a row with a checked state, ticked when selected.

props.name: checkmark
props.description: The check mark at the end of a selected row; on by default.

props.name: nested
props.description: Shows the chevron of a row that opens a submenu.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Shown on hover after the cut label, such as a disabled reason.

components.name: Link
components.description:
Text that takes the user to another page: another site, an email
(`mailto:`), a phone number (`tel:`) or a file to download. In the Next
app, a route of the app is the app's NextLink, built on Link; an action is
a Button.

props.name: look
props.description:
Space-separated styles: `plain` drops the dotted line, for a link its place
already marks, like a site name in a header.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Styles its only child, a link component that takes the `href`.

components.name: Input
components.description:
A single-line text field: names, emails, phones, links, titles. In a form,
wire it through `Controller`; `delay` saves as the user types.

`onChange` waits this many ms without typing; the text shows at once. Blur,

props.name: type
props.description:
`email`, `tel` and `url` bring phone keyboards. Numbers take NumberInput,

components.name: NumberInput
components.description:
A number field: a price, a count, a capacity. `onChange` gets the number as
it's typed, or after `delay`; `null` while empty. Arrow keys and
PageUp/PageDown step it, Home and End go to `min` and `max`, and blur or
Enter moves it into them.

components.name: PasswordInput

A password field with a button at its end that shows or hides the text.

props.description: Shown on hover over the box, above any disabled reason.

props.name: ref
props.description: Reaches the control's focusable element.

components.name: CheckIcon
components.description:
The check mark of checkboxes and selected rows, heavier than a plain icon for
small sizes. General checks come from lucide-react.

components.name: LoadingIcon
components.description:
A spinning icon for work in progress, hidden from assistive tech unless
named with `aria-label`. Beside text or in a live region, not inside a
Button or Select: they have a `loading` prop.

components.name: MinusIcon
components.description:
The minus mark of checkboxes and selected rows partly on, heavier than a
plain icon for small sizes. General minus glyphs come from lucide-react.

components.name: FormControl
components.description:
A form field's label, control box, and help text or status message, around a
control the design system has no component for. Input, NumberInput,
PasswordInput, SearchInput and Select are built on it: prefer those. With
`Controller`, `{...field}` is all it needs.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description:
The ids of elements that name the control, like a section's heading,
for a control with no `label`.

props.name: id
props.description: The control's id; generated when left out.

props.name: name
props.description: The control's name; else the label, the placeholder, then the id.

props.name: hint
props.description: Shown in a tooltip from the info icon after the label.

props.name: labelRightSlot
props.description: At the end of the label's row; shown only with a label.

props.name: error
props.description:
Each status takes `true` for the style alone, or a message to show.
Error wins over warning, and warning over success.

props.name: look
props.description: Space-separated styles: `outline` (default) or `open`.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Shown on hover over the box, above any disabled reason.

props.name: ref
props.description: Reaches the control's focusable element.

props.name: children
props.description: Renders the control, given its element's attributes.

props.name: withControlBox
props.description:
Draws the control box around the control; `true` by default. `false`
for a control that is its own box, like Select's trigger: it renders a
`ControlBox`, and the control gets the box's props.

props.name: className
props.description: For the field's root, around the label, the box and the messages.

components.name: ControlBox
components.description:
The control's box: look, icons, add-ons, spinner and tooltip. FormControl
draws it around the control; a control that is its own box renders it, and
FormControl passes the state.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Shown on hover over the box, above any disabled reason.

props.name: look
props.description: Space-separated styles: `outline` (default) or `open`.

components.name: ControlMessage
components.description:
A field's status message: a live region kept on the page while empty, so a
new message is announced. Without a status it's styled as help text.

props.name: status
props.description: Styles the message as that status; without one, it's help text.

components.name: ControlLabel
components.description: The label's row: the label, its required mark and hint, then `rightAddOn`.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Shown on hover of the label, above its full text when cut off.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Left out, a press activates the labelled control natively.

components.name: Controller
components.description:
Puts one form field under react-hook-form: validation goes in `rules`, and
`{...field}` gives the control its name, value, `onChange`, focus on a failed
submit, `required` mark and `error`. Every field in a `useForm` form renders
through it.

props.name: children
props.description: Renders the field's control: `{({ field }) => <Input {...field} />}`.

components.name: ErrorBoundary
components.description:
Shows a fallback in place of `children` once they throw while rendering,
so one broken part doesn't take down the page. It doesn't catch errors in
event handlers, effects, promises or iframes. The fallback can offer
`reset`, and `resetKeys` renders `children` again on its own.

props.name: fallback
props.description:
Shown in place of `children` once something below throws, inside an
alert; `null` renders nothing. Default: "Something went wrong." and a
"Try again" button. A function gets `error` and `reset`.

props.name: resetKeys
props.description: While failed, a change in any of these renders `children` again.

components.name: Dropdown
components.description:
A menu of actions or choices behind a trigger button: row actions, an
account menu, sort by, view options. Menu roles, focus and keyboard built in.

props.name: showCheckbox
props.description: A checkbox before each row with a checked state.

props.name: showCheckmark
props.description: A check mark after each checked row; on by default.

props.name: children
props.description:
One trigger element that forwards refs, events and attributes:
`Dropdown.Button`, an `IconButton`… The Dropdown's reason reaches it as
`disabledWithReason` or `loadingWithReason`, for its tooltip.

props.name: align
props.description: Defaults to `end`.

components.name: Dialog
components.description:
A task over the page that waits until it's done or dismissed: editing a
session, inviting a speaker. Its children are the body, which scrolls
between the title and the footer's actions. A yes-or-no question is
openConfirmationDialog.

props.name: title
props.description: Names the dialog, at its top.

props.name: description
props.description: Under the title, and what screen readers read after it.

props.name: headerAction
props.description:
The dialog's own action, like Invite, before the close button. Outside
the title: it doesn't name the dialog.

props.name: children
props.description: The body: it scrolls between the header and the footer.

props.name: footer
props.description: The actions, or a function given `close`, which closes the dialog.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Opens the dialog on press: one element that forwards refs and events.

props.name: closable
props.description:
Whether the close button, Escape and a press outside close it; `true`
by default. Without them, only the footer's actions do.

props.name: className
props.description: For the dialog, which renders outside the trigger's parent.

components.name: Chip
components.description:
A compact toggle showing whether it's on: a standalone filter (`active`,
"Starred only") or one choice of a ChipGroup. Read as a checkbox, or a radio
in a single-choice group. A removable chosen value is a Tag; an action is a
Button.

props.name: look
props.description:
Space-separated styles, any order: `outline` or `filled` (a group's mode
picks one), `ghost`, `rounded`.

props.name: tooltip
props.description:
Shown on hover and focus, above any state reason. Read as the description
unless it repeats the name.

components.name: ChipGroup
components.description:
Chips for 2 to about 8 short visible choices: one (`mode="single"`, default,
like radios) or any number (`mode="multiple"`, like checkboxes). Named by
`label`, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. A form field with label, help
text and message; in a form, `{...field}` from Controller is all it needs.
Longer lists are a Select or MultiSelect.

props.name: id
props.description: The control's id; generated when left out.

props.name: hint
props.description: Shown in a tooltip from the info icon after the label.

props.name: error
props.description:
Each status takes `true` for the style alone, or a message to show.
Error wins over warning, and warning over success.

props.name: name
props.description: The control's name; else the label, the placeholder, then the id.

props.name: labelRightSlot
props.description: At the end of the label's row; shown only with a label.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Runs once focus leaves the group.

props.name: ref
props.description: Reaches the group's element, which takes focus from its label.

props.name: look
props.description:
Space-separated styles: `collapsed` joins the chips into one bar, its
own row, with one border between chips and rounded outer corners only.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description:
A checkbox labeled by its children, to its right: a yes/no choice like
consent or a setting, or one of a CheckboxGroup.

props.name: hint
props.description: Shown in a tooltip from the info icon after the label.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the label with `*`.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Shown on hover over the box, and on focus, above any reason.

props.name: name
props.description: Outside a CheckboxGroup, what it submits under `name` in a form.

props.name: id
props.description: The box's id; generated when left out.

props.name: className
props.description: For the row, around the box and its label.

props.name: style
props.description: For the row, around the box and its label.

props.name: checked
props.description:
Checked state, yours to hold with `onCheckedChange`; `'indeterminate'`
for a parent with partly checked children.
In a CheckboxGroup, the group's `value` decides it.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: A click on an indeterminate box checks it.

props.name: value
props.description:
What it submits under `name` in a form.
What it adds to its CheckboxGroup's value.

props.name: children
props.description: The label, to the right of the box.

components.name: CheckboxGroup
components.description:
Checkboxes answering one question, with label, help text and error. Its value
is the checked boxes' values. No layout: lay out with `className`.

props.name: id
props.description: The control's id; generated when left out.

props.name: hint
props.description: Shown in a tooltip from the info icon after the label.

props.name: error
props.description:
Each status takes `true` for the style alone, or a message to show.
Error wins over warning, and warning over success.

props.name: name
props.description: The control's name; else the label, the placeholder, then the id.

props.name: labelRightSlot
props.description: At the end of the label's row; shown only with a label.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Runs once focus leaves the group.

props.name: ref
props.description: Reaches the group's element, which takes focus from its label.

components.name: Card
components.description:
A bordered container with padding and gap, for one item's content or a large
option in a CardGroup. `onClick` makes the whole card one button; a card with
its own links or buttons stays static.

props.name: look
props.description:
Space-separated styles, any order: `outline` or `filled` (a group's mode
picks one), `elevated`, `ghost`.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child element as the card, such as an `li` of a list.

props.name: ref
props.type: ((instance: HTMLDivElement | null) => void | (() => VoidOrUndefinedOnly)) | RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null> | ((instance: HTMLElement | null) => void | (() => VoidOrUndefinedOnly)) | RefObject<...> | null

props.name: onClick
props.description:
Makes the whole card a button; not with `asChild`, which would make
the child one too.

components.name: CardGroup
components.description:
Cards for a few large visible choices: one (`mode="single"`, default, like
radios) or any number (`mode="multiple"`, like checkboxes). A form field with
label, help text and message; in a form, `{...field}` from Controller is all
it needs.

props.name: id
props.description: The control's id; generated when left out.

props.name: hint
props.description: Shown in a tooltip from the info icon after the label.

props.name: error
props.description:
Each status takes `true` for the style alone, or a message to show.
Error wins over warning, and warning over success.

props.name: name
props.description: The control's name; else the label, the placeholder, then the id.

props.name: labelRightSlot
props.description: At the end of the label's row; shown only with a label.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Runs once focus leaves the group.

props.name: ref
props.description: Reaches the group's element, which takes focus from its label.

components.name: Button
components.description:
An action the user takes: submit a form, save, publish, delete, open a
menu. `variant="default"` is the main action of a view, `base` a secondary
one, `danger` one that destroys. Navigation is a Link or NextLink, or a
Button `as` Next.js's Link where it must look like one; an icon alone is an
IconButton.

props.name: as
props.description:
Forwards props, ref and className to the interactive root, whose look
Button owns; inline styles and important rules override it.

props.name: tooltip
props.description:
Shown on hover and focus, above any state reason. Read as the description
unless it repeats the name.

props.name: look
props.description: Space-separated styles, in any order: `ghost`, `rounded`.

components.name: IconButton
components.description:
An action shown as an icon alone, where space is tight or the icon is
universal: settings, close, delete, more. Its `tooltip` shows the name and
is its accessible name; `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` gives another.

props.name: as
props.description:
Forwards props, ref and className to the interactive root, whose look
Button owns; inline styles and important rules override it.

props.name: look
props.description: Space-separated styles, in any order: `ghost`, `rounded`.

components.name: PlainButton
components.description:
Button behavior with no look, for an element that must act as a button but
keep its own look: an avatar, an info icon, an image. Its one child, a
non-interactive element like a `span` or `img`, becomes the button: named,
focusable, pressed by Enter and Space. A styled action is a Button or
IconButton; a card is a Card.

props.name: tooltip
props.description:
Shown on hover and focus, above any state reason. Read as the description
unless it repeats the name.

components.name: Avatar
components.description:
A round picture of a person, or their initials without one. Hidden from
assistive tech by default, with no tooltip: it usually sits beside the
visible name. Pass `aria-hidden={false}` when it stands for the person on
its own, and it can be focused to show the name in a tooltip.

components.name: Accordion
components.description:
Sections that open and close under their headings: an FAQ, a long form's
optional parts. Each `Accordion.Item` is one section. One open at a time
(`mode="single"`, default) or any number (`mode="multiple"`). Arrow keys,
Home and End move between the headings. One section alone is a
Collapsible; one that always shows is a Section.

props.name: mode
props.description:
One section open at a time (default); opening one closes the other.
Any number of sections open.

props.name: value
props.description:
The open section's `value`; `''` for none.
The open sections' `value`s.

props.name: look
props.description: `bordered` (default): a frame around the sections. `open`: dividers only.

props.name: children
props.description: `Accordion.Item`s.

components.name: Collapsible
components.description:
One Section whose heading shows and hides its content: details the user
opens on demand, like advanced settings. Several are an Accordion.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading's text; its level comes from how deep the section sits.

props.name: description
props.description: A muted line under the heading that says what the section holds.

props.name: headerAction
props.description: Controls at the header's end, like a Create button.

props.name: look
props.description: `bordered` (default): a frame around the sections. `open`: dividers only.

components.name: PageErrorBoundary
components.description:
The error boundary around every page: a page that throws shows the
fallback, and the next navigation retries. The path is known only on the
client, so this sits inside UIRoot, a server component.

components.name: NextLink
components.description:
A link to a route of this app, like `/events/42`: Next.js navigates to it
without reloading the page, and prefetches it. It looks like Link, which
is for other sites, emails and files.

props.name: look
props.description:
Space-separated styles: `plain` drops the dotted line, for a link its place
already marks, like a site name in a header.

props.name: href
props.description:
The path or URL to navigate to. It can also be an object.
@example https://nextjs.org/docs/api-reference/next/link#with-url-object

props.name: replace
props.description:
Replace the current `history` state instead of adding a new url into the stack.
@defaultValue `false`

props.name: scroll
prefetch
props.description:
Prefetch the page in the background.
Any `<Link />` that is in the viewport (initially or through scroll) will be prefetched.
Prefetch can be disabled by passing `prefetch={false}`. Prefetching is only enabled in production.

In App Router:
- "auto", null, undefined (default): For statically generated pages, this will prefetch the full React Server Component data. For dynamic pages, this will prefetch up to the nearest route segment with a [`loading.js`](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/loading) file. If there is no loading file, it will not fetch the full tree to avoid fetching too much data.
- `true`: This will prefetch the full React Server Component data for all route segments, regardless of whether they contain a segment with `loading.js`.
- `false`: This will not prefetch any data, even on hover.

In Pages Router:
- `true` (default): The full route & its data will be prefetched.
- `false`: Prefetching will not happen when entering the viewport, but will still happen on hover.
@defaultValue `true` (pages router) or `null` (app router)

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Optional event handler for when the `<Link>` is navigated.
